title: Cube-sum of Fourier coefficients bounded by the maximum
statement:
Let $p$ be a prime, let $n \ge 0$, and let $f : \bbz_p^n \to \bbz_p$ be a function, whose lift to roots of unity is $\widetilde{f}(x) = \omega_p^{f(x)}$ with $\omega_p = e^{2\pi i/p}$. Write $\widehat{\widetilde{f}}(s)$ for the Fourier coefficient of $\widetilde{f}$ at frequency $s \in \bbz_p^n$. If $A \in \bbr$ is such that $\bigl\|\widehat{\widetilde{f}}(s)\bigr\| \le A$ for every $s \in \bbz_p^n$, then
\[
  \sum_{s \in \bbz_p^n} \bigl\|\widehat{\widetilde{f}}(s)\bigr\|^3
  \;\le\;
  A \sum_{s \in \bbz_p^n} \bigl\|\widehat{\widetilde{f}}(s)\bigr\|^2.
\]
hypotheses_covered: every Fourier coefficient of the lift has norm at most A
